key.answer_key: No. All four TA groups give 185-380 a.u. of TAOH fluorescence, so the Cu(II)+MoO3 condition shows only about a twofold gain over the blank rather than the dramatic, far-faster rate the claim implies -- it is not an on/off signal.
key.grading: Answer key: the audit ruling on the panel (a2), which is the graded target for this trace.
